choices.logText: All books seem to be gone except for one titled 'The Silly Caterpillar'. I wonder what it's about.
The cool shadow helps you rest, but as time passes, you grow hungry and thirsty.

abandonedHospital.text: You stumble upon an abandoned hospital.

choices.logText: You walk into a glass door. But inside, you find some vicodin inside a lupus textbook, along with some other stuff.
You start walking back to your base, but feel something calling to you, so you return to the hospital. Inside, you get chased and attacked by a tall man with a cane. He steals some vicodin.

marioKart.text: You find a tv system with Mario Kart launced on it. Pick a map.

choices.logText: You have good taste. You deserve a reward.
What is wrong with you.

dog.text: You stumble across a cute dog.

choices.logText: Her name is Lexi. You gave her a treat. You feel warm inside.
Should've pet her.

bioLab.text: You enter an abandoned school bio lab. There are some lab instruments laying around.

choices.text: Empty pipette contents on petri dish.
choices.logText: You create a yeast monster. It attacks you.
A small stash was hidden inside — and so was mold.

hobo.text: You come face-to-face with a hobo.

choices.logText: He tickles you. You are uncomfortable.
You steal his supplies. He doesn't seem too pleased.

mtWashington.text: You hike up a Mt Washington for supplies and stumble upon a crew on their way up. They are so close to the top but cannot decide whether to continue, despite having inadequate gear. What should they do?

choices.logText: They all die, but thankfully they had plenty of supplies.
They turn around and survive. They give you some food and water as a reward.
You drink the water. You feel stronger, but your skin glows green.
You cool down.

ratKing.text: You stumble upon a tribe of irradiated rats worshiping a massive, cheese-encrusted rat king.

choices.logText: You earn their trust and are gifted a mysterious block of glowing cheese (it's edible, somehow).
You fight bravely and win! The rats flee, dropping bits of scrap as they squeak in terror.
You don a crown of cheese and lead them in song. You're not sure what's in the cheese, but you feel powerful.

mysteriousBroadcast.text: An old radio crackles to life, playing a distorted jingle: 'Come to Uncle Grizz's Happy Dome™… population: YOU!'

choices.logText: You find a bunker filled with animatronics and scrap. Also: an uncomfortable amount of clown imagery.
You destroy it with primal force. The static stops. You feel… slightly less haunted.
You hear a whisper: 'Pain is temporary. Vicodin is forever.' You pocket a pill that materializes from the speaker grill.

sentientToaster.text: You discover a sentient toaster floating 3 feet off the ground. It speaks: 'I require sacrifice… or rye bread.'

choices.logText: The toaster hums with pleasure. It toasts your offering and blesses you with perfectly crispy vibes.
You beep wildly. The toaster beeps back. Somehow, you earn its respect and receive a vial of RAD-X in return.
Big mistake. It unleashes the fury of the Burnt Bagel Protocol™. You are lightly crisped and deeply humbled.

diagnosisTent.text: You come across a half-collapsed medical tent with a grumpy doctor popping Vicodin and muttering, 'It's never lupus.'

choices.logText: He saves your life while insulting your intelligence. You feel better but vaguely insulted.

choices.text: Steal some supplies while he's ranting.
choices.logText: You pocket a medkit and some Vicodin while he monologues about sarcasm being a coping mechanism.
He throws a clipboard at you. 'It's NEVER lupus!' You suffer minor bruising and existential regret.

glowingFungusGrove.text: You enter a grove filled with luminescent mushrooms that pulse softly in the dark.

choices.logText: The mushrooms are strangely tasty but maybe a bit radioactive.
You collect spores that might help with radiation sickness later.

madInventorsWorkshop.text: You find a ramshackle workshop where a wild-eyed inventor invites you to try his latest contraption.

choices.logText: The device boosts your strength but shocks your nerves a bit.

choices.text: Take a spare part and leave
choices.logText: You quietly pocket some useful parts and slip away.

radioactiveRollerDisco.text: An old roller rink blasts 80s hits and glows with neon lights—despite the radiation.

choices.logText: You get a workout but feel the radiation creeping in.
You nab a skate that might come in handy.

psychicCat.text: A mysterious cat with glowing eyes stares at you knowingly.

choices.logText: The cat shares its wisdom, making you feel better.
You miss out on something special.

hauntedVendingMachine.text: A vending machine rattles and hums, dispensing random items.

choices.logText: You get some snacks and water... but they might be slightly radioactive.
You smash it open, taking some scrap but hurting yourself.

brokenArcadeCabinet.text: A flickering arcade cabinet displays pixelated chaos.

choices.logText: You get a rush, but forget to eat.
You salvage valuable electronic components.

crazedBotanist.text: A wild-eyed botanist offers you a strange glowing plant.

choices.logText: The plant heals you but feels a little dangerous.
You grab his notes about radiation-resistant plants.

rogueRobotButler.text: A polite but malfunctioning robot offers you a drink.

choices.logText: The drink boosts your energy but might be contaminated.
You reprogram it to serve you better.

theLostCircus.text: You hear circus music and find a deserted big top with strange performers still practicing.

choices.logText: You gain strength from the workout but feel worn out.
You grab some leftover rations and gear.

invisibleFog.text: A creeping invisible fog surrounds you, humming softly.

choices.logText: The fog drains your vitality but sharpens your muscles.
You rest as the fog passes, feeling slightly better but hungry and thirsty.
